Clara L (BizDev): Quick sync 12: NovaGrid (HW + SI) says they're ready to submit marketplace security materials. They asked whether to use S3 presign or SFTP for uploads. Low friction preferred.
Ravi M: Presign wins from our side. SFTP means extra handoffs and keys. Also ask if they can PGP-encrypt the sensitive files.
Ana V (Security): We accept presigned S3 uploads. Requirements to tell NovaGrid: 1) SOC2 Type II (rolling 12 months) OR SOC bridge letter + attestation; 2) Pen-test from a 3rd-party in last 12 months OR pen remediation attestation + vuln list; 3) Firmware manifests must be signed and include SHA256 checksums; 4) Completed vendor security questionnaire (v3). Redact tenant/customer PII from logs. If they want longer presigns, require client-side encryption and Legal signoff.
Omar T (Cloud Ops): Operational note: our default presign TTLs are 72h for questionnaires/artifacts, 7 days for heavy artifacts like SOC/pen reports. We'll create artifact-specific folders: s3://redwood-marketplace/novagrid/soc2/, /pen-test/, /firmware/, /questionnaire/ so owners map cleanly. Presigns will be generated via an internal API (no manual CLI unless needed). Example we can share right away:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/novagrid/pen-test/novagrid-2026-03-18-pen.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Wei Z (Partner Eng): NovaGrid asks for 14-day links (their ops team is slow). Is that negotiable? They also asked if we can accept a single zip with subfolders.
Ana V (Security): 14 days is a risk vector for leaked links. We won't do >7 days without encryption + Legal approval. Zip with subfolders is fine but insist on checksums for each file and a manifest.csv listing filenames + SHA256.
Clara L (BizDev): LegalBot, can you weigh in on retention? NovaGrid wants us to keep artifacts for 5 years for their auditors.
LegalBot: Default retention for marketplace vendor artifacts = 3 years. Extension to 5+ years requires a Data Retention Addendum signed by both parties and a documented business justification. Data classification: SOC/pen/firmware = CONFIDENTIAL. Encryption-at-rest required; client-side encryption recommended for long retention.
Ravi M: Action items I'm capturing: 1) Draft partner email + checklist + naming conventions (Ravi) 2) Presign flow + runbook + API stub (Omar) 3) Security acceptance criteria + redaction snippets (Ana) 4) SI/firmware validation checklist (Wei) 5) Legal retention exception if needed (Legal). Target: NovaGrid uploads within 7 business days.
Omar T (Cloud Ops): I'll push a short runbook and sample presign commands to the doc. For immediate share, use this 3-day example:
```bash
# 3-day presign (259200 seconds)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/novagrid/questionnaire/novagrid-security-q3-2026.pdf --expires-in 259200
```
Ana V (Security): Also require: remediation plan with severity mapping (critical/high/medium/low) and ETAs; a checksum file (SHA256) next to each artifact; and a redaction log that indicates what was removed from logs (IPs, emails, account IDs). Example redaction placeholder: user_email -> <redacted_email_sha256>.
Wei Z (Partner Eng): I'll coordinate the manifest and checksums with NovaGrid and ask about their PGP fingerprint.
Clara L (BizDev): I'll schedule the kickoff and send the checklist. Target timeline: partner to upload in 7 business days. Thanks all :tada:
AuditBot: Reminder scheduled for +7 business days from thread creation (vendor-novagrid-upload).
LegalBot: Note logged: vendor-novagrid-retention-request. Follow-up assigned to Legal (C. Li).
